Self-refuting idea | Self-refuting ideas or self-defeating ideas are ideas or statements whose falsehood is a logical consequence of the act or situation of holding them to be true.  Many ideas are called self-refuting by their detractors, and such accusations are therefore almost always controversial, with defenders stating that the idea is being misunderstood or that the argument is invalid.  For these reasons, none of the ideas below are unambiguously or incontrovertibly self-refuting. Marrow (vegetable) | A marrow is a vegetable, the mature fruit of certain "Cucurbita pepo" cultivars.
